units.source_text: 太政大臣上表致仕，退隐在家。

en.t: The Grand Minister submitted a memorial resigning his office and withdrew into private life at home.

units.source_text: 他对人说：“鉴于人世无常，至尊皇帝尚且要让位，

en.t: He said to others, "Considering the impermanence of human life, even the most exalted emperor must yield the throne,

units.source_text: 何况我此衰老之身，挂冠有何足惜！”

en.t: so how could this aged and failing body of mine have anything to regret in hanging up the cap of office?"

units.source_text: 髭黑左大将升任了右大臣，执行天下政令。

en.t: Higekuro, the Left Captain, was promoted to Minister of the Right and took charge of the realm's government orders.

units.source_text: 承香殿女御等不到儿子即帝位，先已逝世。

en.t: The Kokiden lady-in-waiting had died before she could see her son ascend the throne.

units.source_text: 现在追封为太后，然而犹如空花泡影，无补于事了。

en.t: She was now posthumously honored as empress dowager, but it was as empty as flowers in the sky or shadows on bubbles, of no help at all.

units.source_text: 六条院的明石女御所生大皇子，现在立为皇太子。

en.t: The eldest prince born to the Akashi Consort of Rokujo-in was now installed as crown prince.

units.source_text: 此事早在意料之中，现在成为事实，自然更加庆喜，令人心驰目眩。

en.t: This had long been expected, and now that it had become reality, the joy was naturally even greater, dazzling people's hearts and eyes.

units.source_text: 夕雾右大将升任大纳言，顺次晋爵，又兼任了左大将。

en.t: Yugiri, the Right Captain, was promoted to major counselor, advanced in rank in due order, and also assumed the post of Left Captain.

units.source_text: 夕雾和髭黑的交情便更见亲睦了。

en.t: The friendship between Yugiri and Higekuro thus became still closer and more cordial.

units.source_text: 源氏为了冷泉帝让位后没有亲生皇子嗣位，心中颇感不满。

en.t: Genji felt considerable dissatisfaction that, after Emperor Reizei abdicated, no prince of his own body succeeded him.

units.source_text: 新皇太子原也是源氏血统；然而，冷泉帝在位期间虽然平安过去，

en.t: The new crown prince was also of Genji's bloodline; yet although Emperor Reizei's reign had passed peacefully,

units.source_text: 未被揭发那件秘密的罪行，而宿命注定不能子孙世袭皇位，终是遗憾，不免扫兴。

en.t: and that secret sin had not been exposed, destiny had decreed that his descendants could not inherit the throne generation after generation, and this remained regrettable and dispiriting.

units.source_text: 但此事不可告人，只在胸中纳闷。

en.t: But this was something he could tell no one, so he could only brood over it in his heart.

units.source_text: 幸而明石女御生了许多皇子，新帝对她宠爱无比。

en.t: Fortunately, the Akashi Consort had borne many princes, and the new emperor cherished her beyond measure.

units.source_text: 源氏皇族血统的人累代当皇后，世人都引为缺憾。

en.t: People generally considered it a disappointment that women of Genji's imperial bloodline had served as empresses for generations.

units.source_text: 冷泉院的秋好皇后并未生皇子，源氏强把她立为皇后。

en.t: Empress Akikonomu of Reizei-in had borne no prince, yet Genji had insisted on making her empress.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后想起了源氏拔擢之恩，感谢之心与日俱增。

en.t: Empress Akikonomu remembered the favor Genji had shown in raising her up, and her gratitude grew with each passing day.
